name: Innai Kansen
source:
Akira Sakaguchi is a physician who has been appointed to a new Hospital. Rumors about his youth and skill spread fast among the nurses. One day Akira accidentally witnesses an improper behavior of his female colleague doctor after operation and can't forget that mysterious sight.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-september-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
Sakaguchi Akira是一名刚被派往新医院任职的医生。护士们很快便传开了有关他年轻有为、医术高明的传闻。一天，Akira意外目睹一位女医生同事在手术后的不当举动，从此再也忘不掉那幅神秘的景象。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-september-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
